name: Robert Boss
source: Robert Boss is the head of the Fine Arts Department at Arlington Academy. He's beloved by nearly every student in the school due to his lenient classroom policies and his classes are often the most sought-after electives. Not every teacher at the academy appreciates his laissez-faire attitude towards teaching, but it's impossible to deny his talent for nurturing creativity.
